data.name: Fakhirun
data.gender_notes: Fakhirun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who is worthy of honor and pride. The name Fakhirun carries the meaning “Proud, Honorable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fakhirun usually hope their child will grow to embody proud, honorable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a woman who embodies grace, elegance, and honor. She is proud of her accomplishments and carries herself with dignity and pride.
data.etymology: Fakhirun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Proud, Honorable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fakhirun total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: فاخرون
in_arabic.meaning: فاخرون تعني الشخص الذي يتميز بالفخر والشرف العالي
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاخرون هو اسم مشتق من الفخر، وهو الشعور بالعزة والشرف العالي. في اللغة العربية، الفخر يأتي من الجذر 'ف-خ-ر' الذي يعني العزة والتميز. هذا الاسم يعبر عن الشخص الذي يتميز بالكرامة والفخر، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات في سياقات مختلفة، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَيُعَزِزُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ' (آل عمران: 26)، حيث يرتبط الفخر بالعزة الإلهية.

in_urdu.name: فاخرون
in_urdu.meaning: فاخرون کا مطلب ہے فخر و عزت والا شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاخرون ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے فخر و عزت والا شخص۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'ف-خ-ر' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے فخر کرنا یا عزت دینا۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام فخر، کرامت، اور اعلیٰ اخلاق کے صفات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لئے استعمال ہوا ہے جو اپنی بہادری، حکمت، اور عزت کے لئے جانے جاتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: फाखिरुन
in_hindi.meaning: फाखिरुन का अर्थ है गर्व और सम्मान वाला व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: फाखिरुन एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है गर्व और सम्मान वाला व्यक्ति। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'फ-ख-र' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है गर्व या सम्मान। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम गर्व, गरिमा और उच्च नैतिक मूल्यों को दर्शाता है। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपनी बहादुरी, ज्ञान और सम्मान के लिए जाने जाते हैं।

in_pashto.name: فاخرون
in_pashto.meaning: فاخرون د معنا دے فخر او عزت لرونکی شخص
in_pashto.long_meaning: فاخرون د يو عربي نوم دی چې د فخر او عزت لرونکی شخص معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'ف-خ-ر' څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې د فخر يا عزت ورکولو معنی لري. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې، دا نوم د فخر، کرامت او لوړو اخلاقو ځانګړتیاوې څرګندوي. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول شوی دی چې د خپل وطن، حکمت او عزت لپاره پېژندل شوي دي.

in_english.name: Fakhirun
in_english.meaning: Fakhirun means a person with high honor and pride
in_english.long_meaning: Fakhirun is an Arabic name derived from the root 'f-kh-r', which signifies pride, honor, and dignity. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with individuals who possess noble qualities, courage, and high moral standards. The name Fakhirun has historical significance in various Muslim cultures, representing a person who is esteemed, respected, and admired for their achievements and character.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fakhirun holds significant cultural importance in the Arabic-speaking Muslim world. It resonates with the deep-rooted values of honor and dignity that are central to Islamic and Middle Eastern societies. The name can be bestowed upon a girl as an expression of pride and respect, reflecting the hope that she will grow up to be a woman of worth and prestige, holding her head high and commanding respect in her community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fakhirun symbolizes the inner dignity and self-worth that is a fundamental aspect of every human being, as emphasized in Islamic teachings. It serves as a reminder that no matter what one's circumstances in life may be, each individual possesses inherent worth and honor, deserving of recognition, respect, and love. The name Fakhirun can inspire its bearer to cultivate qualities of dignity, grace, and self-worth, in turn attracting admiration and respect from others. Through the use of this name, Muslim parents can instill a deep sense of pride and self-worth in their children, ultimately contributing to their personal growth and spiritual development.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Proud, Honorable" symbolizes She who is worthy of honor and pride. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fakhirun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of proud, honorable.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Fakhirun was mentioned in the works of Ibn al-Nadim as a rare name. The name Fakhirun carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Fakhirun was used in the context of Islamic scholarship and literature during the Islamic Golden Age.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Fakhirun remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
